newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, July falls ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, July falls ahead of expiry.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed on Friday with July down sharply on long liquidation ahead of expiry on July 22, traders said.

Other months closed slightly higher with support linked to ongoing concerns of potential crop damage due to dry weather from India to Indonesia. An abnormally dry sowing season has forced farmers in Thailand to delay plantings until August.
Traders said world supply and demand were narrowly balanced and any disruption to Asian production could cause sharp gains in CBOT futures later this year and next.
Trade was said to be thin ahead of the weekend.
CBOT estimated rice volume at 350 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 393 lots.
Rice ended down 21 cents per cwt to up two with July down 21 at $10.70.
